h1. Dynatrace S0 Preview Then Post SILVA and PagerDuty

{info:title=Audience}
SRE / platform engineers who need to understand the Dynatrace Automations workflow that opens a SILVA (ServiceNow) incident and pages PagerDuty when a Davis problem becomes Active.
{info}

{warning:title=Safety}
This workflow *sends* for real when active (creates SILVA incidents and PagerDuty pages). Keep it *Draft* or set {{DRY_RUN = true}} until preview checks pass. Never put SILVA passwords or PagerDuty routing keys in Confluence. Allowlist {{silvastg.service-now.com}} and {{events.pagerduty.com}} before go-live. Disable other PREVIEW / TEST / OPEN workflows so one problem is not handled twice.
{warning}

----

h2. Decision tree

{code}
Davis problem Active (availability / custom / error / resource / slowdown)?
  → extract-event-tags (parse tags + alert fields)
  → resolve-snow-values (SILVA GET lookups)
  → build-payload (SNOW body + PD body + create/skip decision)
      ├─► preview-silva-incident (checks + duplicate GET)
      │     → ready? → post-silva-incident (POST incident)
      │     → not ready / already open / DRY_RUN? → skip
      └─► preview-pagerduty (checks; routing key hidden)
            → ready? → trigger-pagerduty (POST Events API)
            → not ready / DRY_RUN? → skip
 Draft status?
  → Drafts are not triggered — Save / Deploy first
{code}

----

h2. Short takeaway

||Question||Answer||
|What is this workflow?|Dynatrace Automations graph: problem → prepare → preview → post SILVA *and* page PagerDuty|
|UI title (screenshot)|*S0 - PREVIEW then POST to SILVA and PagerDuty v7.1*|
|Safety pattern|Each send task reads *its own* preview and skips if not ready|
|Left branch|preview-silva-incident → post-silva-incident|
|Right branch|preview-pagerduty → trigger-pagerduty|
|Shared prep|extract-event-tags → resolve-snow-values → build-payload|

----

h2. Summary

When a Davis problem opens, this workflow collects tickets and paging data, looks up SILVA (ServiceNow) assignment values with *read-only* GETs, builds both payloads, then runs two parallel branches. Each branch *previews* first (checks fields / duplicates), then *posts* only if that preview says ready. SILVA gets an incident. PagerDuty gets one Events API trigger with dedup key {{dt-problem-<problem_id>}}.

----

h2. Words you need first

||Word||What it means||Why you care||
|Davis problem|Dynatrace “something is wrong” object|Starts the workflow|
|SILVA|AXA ServiceNow instance used for ITSM incidents|Where the ticket is created|
|SNOW|ServiceNow (same world as SILVA)|Field names like {{assignment_group}}|
|Preview task|Build/check payload; usually GET only|Gate before send|
|Post / trigger task|Actually creates ticket or page|Only after preview ready|
|DRY_RUN|Flag in send scripts|{{true}} = log only, no POST|
|dedup_key|PagerDuty unique key for one problem|Stops many pages for same problem|
|correlation_id|Usually Dynatrace problem id on the SILVA ticket|Links ticket ↔ problem|

h2. End-to-end picture

{code}
Problem trigger (Davis Active)
        │
        ▼
extract-event-tags          (Dynatrace event + optional Problems API)
        │
        ▼
resolve-snow-values         (SILVA Table API GET lookups)
        │
        ▼
build-payload               (no network — builds JSON + decision)
        │
        ├──────────────────────────────┐
        ▼                              ▼
preview-silva-incident          preview-pagerduty
  (field checks +               (field checks;
   duplicate GET)                routing key redacted)
        │                              │
        ▼                              ▼
post-silva-incident             trigger-pagerduty
  POST /api/now/v2/table/incident   POST /v2/enqueue
        │                              │
        ▼                              ▼
   SILVA incident                 PagerDuty incident
{code}

h2. Task catalog (all steps)

||#||Task||Position||Runs after||Network?||What it does||
|0|Problem trigger|top|—|Dynatrace events|Starts on Active problem (availability, custom, error, resource, slowdown). Drafts do not fire.|
|1|extract-event-tags|(0,1)|trigger|Optional Dynatrace Problems API|Parses tags and alert fields; builds SNOW inputs (group tags, environment, app code, host, problem URL).|
|2|resolve-snow-values|(0,2)|extract-event-tags|SILVA *GET*|Read-only lookups for business service, offering, assignment group (and related CI logic).|
|3|build-payload|(0,3)|resolve-snow-values|*None*|Builds SILVA incident body, PagerDuty trigger body, and {{create_incident}} / skip decision.|
|4a|preview-silva-incident|(0,4)|build-payload|SILVA *GET* (duplicate check)|Shows body, per-field readiness, duplicate open-incident check.|
|5a|post-silva-incident|(0,5)|preview-silva-incident|SILVA *GET* + *POST*|Skips if preview not ready / already open / DRY_RUN; else creates incident.|
|4b|preview-pagerduty|(1,4)|build-payload|*None* (local checks)|Shows PD body with routing key hidden; readiness flags.|
|5b|trigger-pagerduty|(1,5)|preview-pagerduty|PagerDuty *POST*|Skips if not ready / DRY_RUN; else Events API v2 trigger.|

----

h2. Step-by-step detail and API calls

h3. 0 — Problem trigger

* *Type:* Dynatrace Workflows *davis-problem* event trigger.
* *When:* Problem becomes Active; categories include availability, custom, error, resource, slowdown (as configured).
* *API:* Internal Dynatrace event bus (not a REST call you configure).
* *UI note:* Toggle On in the editor still does nothing while status is *Draft* (“Drafts are not triggered”).

----

h3. 1 — extract-event-tags

* *Type:* JavaScript task ({{dynatrace.automations:run-javascript}}).
* *Inputs:* Trigger {{event}} (problem id, title, tags, entity, URL).
* *Optional API:* Dynatrace Problems / environment URL helpers ({{getEnvironmentUrl}}, optional problem fetch when enabled) to enrich description and problem URL.
* *Outputs (examples):*
** {{problem_id}}, {{problem_url}}, title / description
** {{snow_inputs}} (group tags, environment, app code, host, owner-style fields)
* *No SILVA / PagerDuty calls here.*

----

h3. 2 — resolve-snow-values

* *Type:* JavaScript + HTTP.
* *Purpose:* Map Dynatrace tags / host into SILVA CMDB / group records.
* *Base URL (staging example):* {{https://silvastg.service-now.com}}
* *API pattern:* ServiceNow Table API v2

{code}
GET {SILVA_BASE}/api/now/v2/table/{table}?sysparm_query=...&sysparm_fields=...
Authorization: Basic (stored secret — not in Confluence)
{code}

* *Typical tables looked up (names may vary by mapping logic):*
** Assignment group
** Business service
** Service offering / CI ({{cmdb_ci}})
** Optional: recent {{incident}} history to infer offering for a host CI
* *Method:* *GET only* (read-only).
* *Outputs:* Resolved sys_ids / display names, {{snow_required}} checklist, match method notes.

----

h3. 3 — build-payload

* *Type:* JavaScript.
* *Network:* *None* (pure transform).
* *Builds:*
** {{snow_incident_payload}} — fields such as {{short_description}}, {{assignment_group}}, {{u_business_service}}, {{cmdb_ci}}, {{u_environment}}, {{correlation_id}}, {{u_external_url}}, description, …
** {{pagerduty_payload}} — Events API v2 shape: {{routing_key}} (placeholder/secret), {{event_action: trigger}}, {{dedup_key: dt-problem-<id>}}, {{payload.summary}}, {{severity}}, {{source}}, {{custom_details}}, {{client_url}}
** {{decision.create_incident}} — {{true}} only if required fields present and not in maintenance skip path
* *Missing required fields* → decision skip (both branches will not send).

----

h3. 4a — preview-silva-incident

* *Type:* JavaScript + HTTP GET.
* *Reads:* {{build-payload}} result.
* *Checks:* Required fields present; decision says create; formatting.
* *Duplicate API:*

{code}
GET {SILVA_BASE}/api/now/v2/table/incident?sysparm_query=<open incident for this correlation / problem>
{code}

* *Outputs:* {{ready}}, {{problems[]}}, {{wouldDo}} (CREATE / SKIP …), payload preview.
* *Does not create* the incident.

----

h3. 5a — post-silva-incident

* *Type:* JavaScript + HTTP.
* *Gate:* Runs only if predecessor {{preview-silva-incident}} is OK *and* script sees {{ready}} / create decision.
* *Duplicate GET again* (safety): same open-incident query; if already open → skip and return existing number/URL.
* *DRY_RUN:* if {{true}} → return would-POST body, no create.
* *Create API:*

{code}
POST {SILVA_BASE}/api/now/v2/table/incident?sysparm_display_value=all&sysparm_exclude_reference_link=true
Content-Type: application/json
Body: snow_incident_payload
{code}

* *Success:* Returns incident number / {{sys_id}} and deep link ({{nav_to.do?uri=incident.do?sys_id=…}}).

----

h3. 4b — preview-pagerduty

* *Type:* JavaScript (local validation).
* *Checks examples:* {{dedup_key}} matches {{dt-problem-P-…}} pattern; summary present; decision create; routing key present (value shown as redacted).
* *Outputs:* {{ready}}, {{problems[]}}, preview event JSON with {{routing_key}} hidden.
* *No HTTP* to PagerDuty in this task.

----

h3. 5b — trigger-pagerduty

* *Type:* JavaScript + HTTP.
* *Gate:* Own preview must be ready; decision create; not DRY_RUN.
* *API:*

{code}
POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {
  "routing_key": "<secret>",
  "event_action": "trigger",
  "dedup_key": "dt-problem-<problem_id>",
  "payload": { "summary", "severity", "source", "custom_details": { ... } },
  "client_url": "<Dynatrace problem URL>",
  "links": [ ... ]
}
{code}

* *Note:* Runs *in parallel* with SILVA post, so the SILVA ticket number is usually *not* known yet. Linkage is via {{correlation_id}} / problem id in custom details. Repeating the same {{dedup_key}} while the PD alert is open does not open a second incident.

----

h2. API call summary table

||Task||Direction||Endpoint (pattern)||Purpose||
|extract-event-tags|Dynatrace (optional)|Problems / env URL helpers|Enrich problem fields|
|resolve-snow-values|SILVA GET|{{/api/now/v2/table/{table}}}|Resolve group / service / offering / CI|
|build-payload|—|—|Build JSON only|
|preview-silva-incident|SILVA GET|{{/api/now/v2/table/incident?...}}|Duplicate / readiness|
|post-silva-incident|SILVA GET + POST|incident table|Confirm not open; create incident|
|preview-pagerduty|—|—|Validate PD body|
|trigger-pagerduty|PagerDuty POST|{{https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue}}|Page on-call|

----

h2. Create vs skip (decision)

||Situation||Result||
|Required SILVA fields missing|{{create_incident = false}} → both sends skip|
|Maintenance / skip rule matched|Skip with reason|
|Preview lists {{problems[]}}|Send task skips|
|Open SILVA incident already exists for problem|post-silva skips (no duplicate)|
|{{DRY_RUN = true}}|Send tasks skip real POST|
|Preview ready + create true + DRY_RUN false|SILVA POST and/or PD enqueue run|

----

h2. Parallel branches (why two previews)

* Both branches start after the *same* {{build-payload}}.
* SILVA and PagerDuty do not wait for each other.
* A failure or skip on one side does not automatically cancel the other (each has its own preview gate).
* Operators debug by opening the *preview* task result first ({{ready}}, {{problems}}, {{wouldDo}}).

----

h2. Operator checklist

||Step||Action||
|1|Confirm workflow is not stuck as Draft if you expect live runs|
|2|Allowlist SILVA host + {{events.pagerduty.com}}|
|3|Secrets only in workflow / Connection store (not Confluence, not git)|
|4|Run with {{DRY_RUN true}} or preview-only until {{ready: true}} on both previews|
|5|Disable competing TEST/OPEN workflows|
|6|First live test: low-impact problem; confirm one SILVA ticket + one PD incident|
|7|Confirm {{dedup_key}} / correlation reuse on a second fire|

----

h2. Health check

||Check||Pass||
|Trigger|Active problem starts a run (after Deploy)|
|extract / resolve / build|OK; snow inputs and payloads present|
|preview-silva|{{ready: true}}, {{wouldDo: CREATE}} (or expected SKIP)|
|preview-pagerduty|{{ready: true}}, dedup_key looks like {{dt-problem-P-…}}|
|post-silva|Incident number returned (or skip reason clear)|
|trigger-pagerduty|HTTP 202 / success from Events API (or DRY_RUN skip)|
